_comment: Test input: SOURCE side, MySQL schema JSON in the shorthand form - each column is one type string carrying its keys and a trailing '--' comment. This is what you get by quoting the assignment's Dataset A. Pair it with school_platform.sample_docs.json.

stu_master.stu_cd: VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL UNIQUE  -- human-readable student number
stu_master.enr_stat: CHAR(1) NOT NULL           -- E=Enrolled, G=Graduated, W=Withdrawn
stu_master.gpa_val: DECIMAL(3,2)                -- cumulative GPA on a 4.00 scale
stu_master.enr_dt: DATETIME NOT NULL            -- when the student first enrolled

crs_info.crs_cd: VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL UNIQUE  -- course catalog code
crs_info.is_active: TINYINT(1) NOT NULL       -- 1 = offered this term
